title: Wuhu Island
description:
Get a bird's-eye view of Wuhu Island. This is a 3D live scene featuring a Mii pilot flying around the island setting of games like Wii Sports Resort and Wii Fit Plus.

The chosen Mii (or Mii-related character) is randomized at startup, but you can also specify the one you want to use. The color of the plane can also be customized along with the colors of the jetpack Miis. You can also adjust the time of day or let it change on its own in real time. 

There are additional settings related to the camera, clock, and sound. You can control the Manual camera option by clicking and dragging your mouse across the desktop.

--Resource Rippers--
Centrixe the Dodo | SlashterYT | Tens | Orange Pumpkin | Mystie | SpaceCats | Random Talking Bush | Chaofanatic | lelumini | Hallow | Mii Library

VHS Date and Time by rootkitwolf.
Manual camera (3D Camera) by Gariam.
